title: Dr. Feelbetter
description: From the Super Secret Spy Network, host and evil scientist Dr. Feelbetter invites guests to work out their differences.
quote: I’m so sorry I hurt you, when I wasn’t actually trying to hurt you.
altHero: Dr. Feelbetter, a bald scientist with glasses, talking into a microphone in front of the studio audience
alt2: Dr. Feelbetter kneeling to talk with Perry the platypus
alt3: Dr. Doofenshmirtz grimacing, finding out that Peter the panda is backstage
alt4: Peter lifting up a chair to throw it
